**Software Developer**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Parttime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB.
  
  
https://mathdb.com/
  
  
MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.  
  
We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB.
* Support the development and maintenance of backend servers for MathDB.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of MathDB's backend database infrastructure.
* Support the development and maintenance of Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications.
* Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX).
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback through an iterative development process.
* Experience with version control, software testing, and software engineering best practices.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering polished, production-ready software products beyond the prototype stage.
* Familiarity with cloud computing, containerization, and orchestration technologies.
* Strong interest in mathematical research.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with users and colleagues.
* Familiarity with Lean formalization.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**

We deliver mission-critical AI/ML, software engineering, digital infrastructure, and cybersecurity capabilities on active DoW and IC programs, with cleared engineers across more than 20 states.

**The Role**

INflow is standing up a GitLab Professional Services practice as a subcontracting partner to GitLab. As a Senior GitLab DevSecOps Engineer, you will deliver GitLab-scoped engagements for GitLab's enterprise and public sector customers, working alongside the GitLab PS team under GitLab's methodology, on GitLab-managed statements of work.

The work is cleared, customer-facing, and runs against defined scopes. * Administer GitLab Self-Managed and Dedicated environments: install, upgrade, backup and restore, user and group management, runners, Geo replication, and performance tuning.
* Lead enterprise migrations into GitLab from GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or SVN. Use Congregate and direct transfer. Deploy GitLab reference architectures.
* Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines, including security scanning (SAST, DAST, dependency, container) and compliance framework integration.
* Configure and roll out the GitLab Duo Agent Platform (DAP): build and customize agents and flows, enable AI-assisted development workflows, and advise customers on governance and adoption.
* Deliver customer-facing advisory, clear documentation, and knowledge transfer to agency teams. Lead workshops, cutovers, and secure-environment deployments.
* Operate against defined SOWs with GitLab managing the customer relationship. Scope, estimate, and ship work on schedule.

### **Required Skills:**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or platform engineering.
* Hands-on GitLab administration experience in production (Self-Managed or Dedicated).
* Experience designing, running, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Strong consulting instincts: clear written and verbal communication, ability to lead a customer meeting, and discipline working to a defined scope.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for workshops, cutovers, and secure facilities when needed.

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Active GitLab certifications (GitLab Certified Associate, Professional, or Services Engineer).
* Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform in production.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure in a DevSecOps context.
* Prior work on federal, defense, or intelligence community programs.
* Experience with GitLab Duo, DAP, agentic AI, or AI-assisted development adoption.
* Experience with security scanning toolchains, STIG compliance, or cATO frameworks.

### **What You'll Get:**

* Direct GitLab enablement, training on GitLab PS delivery methods and tooling, and a defined path to GitLab certifications.
* Work on cleared, high-impact engagements across DoW, IC, and civilian federal customers.
* The opportunity to build INflow's GitLab practice from the ground up as a founding member.

Minimum of a DoD Secret clearance is required. Top Secret highly desired.
  
  
Note: this role requires an active DoD clearance held directly by the candidate at the time of application. Top Secret preferred. Candidates without an active clearance will not be considered.

**About Sutton**

Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us.

Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath.

We have raised $6.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see.

We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days.

**The role**

We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders.

There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe.

**What you will do**

You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work:

* Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit
* Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app
* Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks
* Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops
* Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders
* Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data
* Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there.

* You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon
* You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration
* You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them
* You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails
* You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency
* You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship
* You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers

Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors.

**How we work**

Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship.

* **Speed is a feature.** We ship small, ship often and learn from customers.
* **Build fast, run safe.** We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way.
* **Everyone ships.** Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week.
* **Small team, big ownership.** You own outcomes, not tasks.
* **Candor with care.** We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly.

**Why Sutton**

You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university.

* Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets
* Direct access to the founders and to real customers
* A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience
* Location: US based and flexible for the right person, with a bonus for being near our founders in Atlanta or Southern California
* Base salary of $165,000 to $210,000 per year, plus meaningful equity
* Unlimited PTO, 401(k), medical, dental and vision, and team onsites

**How we hire**

The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $210,000.00 per year

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.

Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job.

You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.

You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.

### **What you'll do**

* Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
* Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.

* Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point-to-point automations with maintained, observable ones.

* Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT & Security on credentials and access.
* Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks.
* Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work.

### **What success looks like**

In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be.

 **Requirements**  

* 3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL.
* You have built and shipped at least one LLM-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly.

* Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n.

**Job Summary**  
  
We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB.
  
  
https://mathdb.com/
  
  
MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.  
  
We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.

**About Sutton**

Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us.

Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath.

We have raised $6.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see.

We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days.

**The role**

We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders.

There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe.

**What you will do**

You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work:

* Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit
* Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app
* Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks
* Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops
* Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders
* Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data
* Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there.

* You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon
* You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration
* You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them
* You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails
* You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency
* You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship
* You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers

Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors.

**How we work**

Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship.

* **Speed is a feature.** We ship small, ship often and learn from customers.
* **Build fast, run safe.** We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way.
* **Everyone ships.** Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week.
* **Small team, big ownership.** You own outcomes, not tasks.
* **Candor with care.** We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly.

**Why Sutton**

You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university.

* Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets
* Direct access to the founders and to real customers
* A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience

**How we hire**

The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions.

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.

Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.

You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.

* Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.

Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.

In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be.
